title: Bartsch to Müller, 29 July/8 August 1629
author: Jacob Bartsch
source: Jacob Bartsch's letter to Philipp Müller written at Lauban on 29 July/8 August 1629, sending a copy of Kepler's *Sportula* and announcing his journey to Frankfurt and Strasbourg. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 10. C. 3). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 97.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Bartsch sends Kepler's *Sportula* and announces that he will pass through Leipzig on his way to Frankfurt and Strasbourg.

notes.note: Kepler's *Sportula genethliacis missa* (1629), a short astrological work, printed on his own press at Sagan.
